IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'IntersectType') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[IntersectType]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Subject] [varchar](50) NULL, [SubjectID] [int] NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NULL, [IsSystem] [bit] NULL, [State] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntersectType_State] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [PredicateID] [int] NULL, [SubjectCardinality] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntersectType_SubjectCardinality] DEFAULT (2) NOT NULL, [ObjectCardinality] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntersectType_ObjectCardinality] DEFAULT (2) NOT NULL, [SubjectUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [ObjectUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_IntersectType_uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_IntersectType] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ), CONSTRAINT [UQ_IntersectType] UNIQUE CLUSTERED ( [Subject] ASC, [SubjectID] ASC, [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC, [PredicateID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_IntersectType_Object') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_IntersectType_Object] ON [dbo].[IntersectType] ( [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_IntersectType_PredicateID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_IntersectType_PredicateID] ON [dbo].[IntersectType] ( [PredicateID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_IntersectType_Subject') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_IntersectType_Subject] ON [dbo].[IntersectType] ( [Subject] ASC, [SubjectID] ASC ) END

CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[IntersectType_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[IntersectType] FOR INSERT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
INSERT INTO [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], [ObjectID]) select 'Add', [queue].WriteIndexXml('', 'IntersectType', ID, coalesce(UpdatedBy, 0)), 'IntersectType', ID from inserted END
